scope: Isolated macOS x86_64 Unity 2017.2.2p2, Apple M5 host; developer-only native water experiment
baseline: Framework DLL 7e16f411cf704dddb38d24b2547354a02ab2b6b869ac8f4f74a14d54ccad929e with existing water optimization enabled; no graphics changes

method.pairing: Adjacent trials; only compare pairs with identical focus counts and zero transitions.
method.quantiles: Sorted samples at floor((n-1)*p). Pooled metrics combine all frames within each arm; trial summaries are also retained.
method.hostLoad: Other task-owned FTK game instances and host workloads were active or changing during this session. They were not paused or controlled.
method.scopeLimits: Two camera views of one early-game town area, not different biomes or representative gameplay. No combat/co-op/Windows/Linux performance claim. Matched focus does not control external CPU/GPU load.
method.nativeSafety: Synchronous pinned arrays on the game thread; native code retains no array pointers. Original cursor advancement, mesh lookup and uploads remain. Native rejected inputs fall back; native machine faults cannot be recovered by managed fallback.

reuse-a.limitation: Whole-normal caching had about 12.5% reuse and inconsistent performance. Not adopted.

native-a.limitation: One adjacent pair has different focus conditions. Native companion hash was not recorded for this earlier normals-only exploratory binary. Do not use pooled values as a matched comparison.
